title: Cave hunt
tagline: Track the creature in the caves by the clues it leaves.
teaser: Wander a network of caves, read the drafts and the smells, and find the creature before it finds you.

manPage.synopsis: wump — move between caves, read the clues, aim with care.
manPage.description: Dave Taylor’s version of the classic cave-hunting puzzle: work out where the creature hides from what you sense nearby.

howToPlay: Move from cave to cave through the tunnels.
Drafts, smells and noises hint at what is nearby.
Work out where the creature hides and aim carefully.
